slides.title: HVAC and plumbing owners: 3 questions
slides.body: The paperwork quiz nobody studies for.

slides.title: Q1: The client wants your COI today. Which one goes out?
slides.body: Not last year's PDF. Old certificates show old dates, and clients check.

slides.title: Q2: Do your techs' certifications expire on the same day?
slides.body: Nope. Every card, every tech, its own date.

slides.title: Q3: Where does the insurance renewal notice go?
slides.body: If it's the inbox of whoever set it up years ago, go check. Save this.
